A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 2Ki.17.4 
§ So = "concealed"
a king of Egypt (perhaps only the vizier of the king)

top.gloss: and they may be turned back

entries.def:
1) to move, go, turn back, move away, backslide
1a) (Qal) to backslide, prove recreant to
1b) (Niphal)
1b1) to turn oneself away, turn back
1b2) to be turned or driven back, be repulsed
Also means: sug (שׂוּג "to turn back" H7734)

1) to fence about
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to fence about
1a2) fenced about (participle)

1) council, counsel, assembly
1a) council (of familiar conversation)
1a1) divan, circle (of familiar friends)
1a2) assembly, company
1b) counsel
1b1) counsel (itself)
1b2) secret counsel
1b3) familiar converse, intimacy (with God)

A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.13.10; 
father of: Gaddiel (H1427) 
§ Sodi = "acquaintance"
father of Gaddiel, the spy selected from the tribe of Zebulun

A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.55 
§ Sotai = "changeful"
ancestor of a family of Solomon's servants who returned from exile with Zerubbabel
